_source: measured 2026-10-26 census (code lines: non-blank, non-comment): the 2026-10-12 census carried forward with every change since 12 Oct measured by the same rules

_source_detail.measured: 2026-10-26, from the git trees as committed through 25 Oct (Atlas: branch next, the main checkout, 16 commits ahead of production), against the trees the same branches had at the 12 Oct cutoff
_source_detail.method: The 12 Oct census script (loc.js) is no longer on this machine. workspace/1026/count-lines.js re-implements its recorded rules and was checked against the 12 Oct figures first: it reproduces Fly brain (42,972 lines, 301 files) and Spotify Auto-Pause (8,740, 12 files) exactly and this site within 17 lines (77,184 vs 77,167); on the 12 Oct trees of Mantle, Atlas, Quartz and Helm it lands within 0.1-1.3% (the rest is untracked files and the second sources such as ~/helm-site). So each group is its 12 Oct figure plus the change between its 12 Oct and 25 Oct trees, counted by that script (workspace/1026/census-delta.js). Groups with no new commits and no code file changed since 12 Oct (Arkhe, the portal, the prototypes, Spotify Auto-Pause, the parts in plain folders) keep their 12 Oct figures; the design explorations add the seven files created in their working tree after 12 Oct, less the five that are copies of Atlas files (workspace/1026/census-design.js). Mission Control is recounted whole, and the tools added to ~/.claude/tools after 12 Oct, cloudtest, VOLT and one new private project are counted whole (workspace/1026/census-extra.js). Cross-group copies of files added since 12 Oct were checked with the census rule (line-set Jaccard >= 0.7, workspace/1026/census-neardup.js): four files Quartz shares with Mantle (852 lines) and the change to the shared look-sync.js are counted once, under Mantle.
_source_detail.exclusions: node_modules, venvs and every package/cache/build-output directory (dist, build, out, release, coverage, .next and the rest); vendored and third-party code (vendor dirs, license-banner files such as bundled marked/purify); minified, bundled, hashed and .d.ts files; generated Prisma migrations; saved web pages; lockfiles, JSON, CSV and other data files (not code extensions); Markdown (counted separately, not included); git worktrees, second clones, deploy copies (mantle-live, news-shadow-deploy, portfolio-site-live, the packaged Quartz build), backups, scratch folders and Claude background-job copies; the frozen _explore/i2 snapshot of this site; skills synced from claude.ai; class notes; and work that is not Owen's (third-party projects kept on this machine, a third-party fly-brain reference model). Since 12 Oct also: the staging and scratch clones made to publish the public repos, a third-party repository cloned to review it, and two folders of post drafts and test screenshots.
_source_detail.tool: count-lines.js (node, no external counter), same rules as loc.js: git ls-tree / ls-files file lists, per-language comment rules (HTML includes its inline CSS comments), exact copies counted once. Raw totals for the whole census are not re-derivable from a carried-forward figure and are not given.
_source_detail.previous: The 2026-10-12 census gave 875,541 code lines in 3,364 files (47 projects); the 2026-09-14 census gave 408,364 in 1,355. The growth since 12 Oct is mostly Mantle (+71.5k), Quartz (+75.9k), Helm (+13.2k), the site and two projects new to the census.
_source_detail.rounding: Every figure is a whole-line count; display strings round to one decimal place in thousands.
changes_since_12_oct: everything else +28175 lines, +142 files (Atlas marketing research +700, VOLT 6420, a new private project 21055)
_source_detail.removed_27_oct: Owen, 27 Oct 2026: two Side projects entries were a collaborator’s repositories and came off the site. The 12 Oct census (loc.js) had counted three rows for them, carried unchanged into 26 Oct: the two repositories at Owen’s git-blame share (34% and 17%; 1,196 code lines in 39 files and 495 in 24) and a plain folder of brand files for one of them (725 in 3). All three came out of "everything else": 2,416 lines, 66 files, 3 projects; TypeScript -1,056, HTML -1,075, CSS -285 (split re-derived with loc.js’s blame rule; workspace/1026/census-collab.js in the site’s working repo). Totals 1,078,354 lines / 4,229 files / 50 projects became 1,075,938 / 4,163 / 47; every share recomputed.

conflicts_with_other_measurements.subject: Browser
conflicts_with_other_measurements.census_says: 136.5k lines (26 Oct census; 60.6k on 12 Oct, 51.3k on 14 Sep)
conflicts_with_other_measurements.other_measurement_says: 63,029 JavaScript lines + 13,218 CSS lines = 76,247 (CONTENT-UPDATE.md §1, `git ls-files | xargs wc -l`) [measured 16 Sep, not re-run]
conflicts_with_other_measurements.why: Different rules. The census counts CODE lines; `wc -l` counts every line including blanks and comments, and `git ls-files` sweeps a different file set. Neither figure is wrong; they are not interchangeable. Do not add them together or present them side by side without saying which rule each used.

conflicts_with_other_measurements.subject: Atlas
